The path consists of six distinct line segments connecting points in sequence:  
(67.45,49.24) → (80.19,21.11) → (55.88,0.55) → (24.51,8.49) → (20.74,44.80) → (42.70,57.61) → back to (67.45,49.24).  

That is 6 vertices and 6 sides, forming a closed polygon.  
A 6-sided polygon is a hexagon.
